scene: High atop the wooden platform, three transit lines depart in different directions.
picture: Flat side-view across the high wooden platform. On the far left, a glass-bottomed boat bobs at a canal dock. Left of centre, the boy in orange vest and white scarf stands facing forward. Up high in the centre swings a yellow chairlift. On the far right, a red sleigh tram sits ready on rails.
shown: a glass-bottomed boat bobbing beside a low canal dock on the far left
a yellow hillside chairlift swinging on its cable up high at the centre
a red sleigh tram waiting on polished frost rails at the far right
